native_context: AEAD key, nonce and authenticated-context lifecycle
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: AEAD key, nonce and authenticated-context lifecycle — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Record primitive/library, stable key identity/rotation domain, nonce allocator persistence and authenticated-data contract. Include restart, concurrent writers and rollback behavior.
controls.controlled_verification: With a nonsecret fixture key, instrument allocation across two writers/restarts and compare key-identity/nonce pairs. Separately use a local valid ciphertext and an invalid tag/context to trace whether plaintext is used before authentication or under the wrong account/purpose.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Equal nonces under different keys are not the same reuse claim. Random-looking values do not establish uniqueness. Tag bytes being stored do not prove verification before use.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Meet the chosen primitive's actual nonce/key contract and verify authenticated context before use. Retest concurrency/restart/rotation and valid data migration/decryption.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
